value.rationale: The canonical eventual-idempotent map records dynamical stabilization in an aperiodic transformation monoid. Its exact fibers plus rank refinement and three independent limiting scales answer a motivated structural question not specified by known raw cardinalities. The geometric typical eventual rank contrasts meaningfully with a typically half-sized original image, and the uniform spatial location plus Gaussian fluctuations describe a genuinely multiscale phenomenon.
